## RSV notification rates by LGA and year of diagnosis, 2023–2025

Use the tabs below to switch between the interactive map and the corresponding
LGA data table.

::: {.panel-tabset}

## Map

Use the year selector in the upper-right corner of the map to switch between
2023, 2024 and 2025.

Use the mouse, trackpad or map controls to zoom and pan. Hover over an LGA to
view its notification rate.

## Data table
Use the selectors above the table to filter records by year of diagnosis and
state or territory.

You can also search by LGA name, LGA code, state or territory, and select a
column heading to change the table's sort order.
